localFirst.databasePolicy: Only dedicated local loopback PostgreSQL is allowed by backup/restore scripts for this project baseline.
localFirst.secretHandling: Never print or package actual credentials; `.env.example` holds names/placeholders only.
localFirst.runMode: Physical/app/device/database/provider tests are deferred until all four package A-Z implementations finish.

databaseBackup.format: PostgreSQL custom-format dump; pg_restore --list validation; SHA-256 sidecar references the final basename; dump and checksum are published from temporary files.
databaseBackup.requiredGuard: TEST only; URL protocol PostgreSQL; hostname loopback; RIDEX_EXPECTED_DATABASE_NAME is mandatory and must exactly match the database name in the URL.

preconditions: TEST environment only; LIVE/PRODUCTION label is rejected
Explicit RIDEX_EXPECTED_RESTORE_DATABASE_NAME (or RIDEX_EXPECTED_DATABASE_NAME) exactly matches the target database name
Explicit destructive restore opt-in after confirming a disposable local TEST database
Backup is a regular non-symlink file
SHA-256 sidecar is mandatory and checked from the backup directory
databaseRestore.warning: The command uses pg_restore --clean --if-exists and can remove database objects. It now fails closed unless the operator identifies the exact database name and explicitly confirms a disposable local TEST target. Use only after reviewing a valid checksum-backed backup.

recoveryTargets.restoreDrill: Required in final physical-test phase; restore only to an explicitly named disposable local TEST database different from the backup source database.
